summary: Verified iter-330c Periodontal Status render-gate fix for Sinus Lift. Static code inspection confirms the fix is correctly in place at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx lines 2233-2243 — the render gate now includes 'Sinus Lift' alongside the other 6 procedure types, mirroring the submit validator at lines 940-947. Backend regression (17 tests) PASSES. Full E2E DOM-level Playwright assertion was attempted but blocked by selector-discovery overhead on the Expo Router + RN-Web custom Dropdown components in the multi-step form (Procedure Type lives in Step 2 / Treatment tab, Periodontal Status in Step 3 / Clinical Exam tab; the full path requires extensive form-fill before reaching the Clinical Exam tab). Recommend main agent run a manual sanity click-through OR the next testing agent picks up the E2E with a longer budget using the documented selectors below.
action_items: Optional: Add data-testid attributes to the Procedure Type Dropdown trigger and to dropdown options (e.g., data-testid='dropdown-procedure-type', data-testid='dropdown-option-Sinus-Lift') to make multi-step E2E tests reliable — the current RN-Web Dropdown has no roles or testids on its trigger button, forcing brittle text-based selectors.

Optional: Main agent can self-verify with a quick manual click-through (login as Gaurav.pandey → New Case → fill minimal patient info → Tab 2 'Treatment' → pick 'Sinus Lift' / Direct / Single Implant → Tab 3 'Clinical Examination' → confirm 'Periodontal Status *' label + info-button + 'Select periodontal status' dropdown are rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at lines 2233-2243 of new-procedure.tsx is the correct, minimal change — single line added to the existing inline procedure-type whitelist. Matches the exact same pattern used in CLINICAL_EXAM_GROUP (iter-330) and num_implants (iter-330b). However, this is the THIRD asymmetric render-vs-validator bug in three iterations driven by *inline hard-coded* procedure-type whitelists rather than reusing the canonical sets in /app/frontend/constants/checklist.ts (e.g., NON_FULL_ARCH_TYPES already contains the exact same 7 types). STRONG RECOMMENDATION: refactor the render gate at line 2233 to use the `NON_FULL_ARCH_TYPES` Set directly — would have prevented all three iter-330x bugs and prevents future drift. The submit validator at lines 940-947 should also reference the same Set.

Multiple inline whitelists across new-procedure.tsx (2973 lines) make it very easy to introduce asymmetric render/validator gates. The file is significantly over the 700-line guideline and should be split into smaller per-section components (e.g., ClinicalExamSection, ProcedureInfoSection).

rca of the issue: Original RCA per main agent is correct and consistent with iter-330/330b pattern: render gate at lines 2233-2238 had hard-coded whitelist of 6 procedure types but EXCLUDED 'Sinus Lift', while the submit validator at lines 940-947 (added iter-328) DEMANDED Periodontal Status for Sinus Lift. User got a deadlock — validator demands a field whose dropdown never renders. Fix at line 2243 adds Sinus Lift to the render gate. Single-line change verified via view_file. Reproduction is no longer possible since the gate now matches the validator. Mitigation already applied.
